rationale: For tactical sports dashboards used on tablets during matches, a light theme with high-contrast dark green/petrol headers ensures legibility under bright arena lights. This leans into 'The Performance Pro' archetype.

headings.description: Tactical, heavyweight, and commanding. Used for main data points and section headers.

body.description: Highly legible geometric sans for fast scanning of dense tabular data.

rules: Use Petrol Blue (#0F3B43) as the accent trigger and Dark Green (#0C3B1E) as the structural anchor.
Never use pure black or generic SaaS blue.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Use Text Shadow on overlays.

layouts.global: Mobile/Tablet-first responsive grid. Override default stretch with align-items: start where needed.
layouts.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. gap-6. Every pixel utilized.
layouts.data_entry_mode: The 'Bento' Grid Protocol. grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-6 with oversized tap targets for iPad.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside cards to avoid text collision.
layouts.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces with 1px subtle borders (border-gray-200). Avoid generic card shadows. Use Neumorphism strictly for large toggle buttons in the 'Registo' page.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular, heavily customized Shadcn buttons. 'Registo' buttons must be oversized (min-h-[80px]) for fast tapping on iPad.
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Flat, dense styles. Left-aligned data, centered metrics.
components.forms: Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Never use native inputs.
components.charts: Shadcn Chart components (Recharts). Color-blind-friendly palettes using the brand colors.
components.navigation: Sticky solid header (z-50) with logo, navigation links, and primary CTA. NO transparent backgrounds over content.

visual_enhancers.borders: Grid borders. border-collapse layouts for stats tables. Subtle right/bottom borders (border-gray-200).
visual_enhancers.motion: Fast micro-interactions. hover:-translate-y-1 on stat cards. No slow animations that hinder rapid data entry.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense tactical clarity. Duotone or bold weights.

hero_bg.description: Futsal goalkeeper action shot. Use for Login screen background with dark green overlay.

dashboard_empty_state.description: Coach with tactical tablet. Use for onboarding or empty states.

brand_logo.description: Lion logo placeholder for 'Leões de Porto Salvo'.

media.rules: Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile. Max overlay opacity bg-black/50 or bg-[#0C3B1E]/60.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='registo-submit-button').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: No generic centered layouts. Use optical alignment.
Prioritize Shadcn UI components but strip the Vercel-look. Apply tactical flat aesthetics.
Create depth via layout hierarchy, not just drop shadows.
Buttons must have interaction animations and hover states that explicitly set text color (e.g., hover:bg-emerald-900 hover:text-white).
Never use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided ones.
Use standard React .js files, not .tsx files.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Setup Tailwind with custom color palette (Dark Green, Petrol Blue, Light Grey). Add Barlow Condensed and Manrope fonts.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Build standard layout with a solid dark green header (z-50) and navigation. NO transparent background for the header.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Develop the 'Registo' page: a tablet-optimized form with massive, high-contrast toggle buttons (using Shadcn primitives) for fast game-action recording.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Develop the 'Base de Dados' page: a dense, analytical dashboard (grid-cols-4) featuring Shadcn tables and Recharts for goalkeeper stat trends.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Ensure all buttons, inputs, and toggles have `data-testid` attributes.
